claim: The NCCIS climate-projections page describes maps comparing a 1971-2000 baseline with 2021-2050 projections, using the median of six dynamically downscaled global climate models under RCP 4.5 and RCP 8.5. This is national climate-screening methodology context, not a street-level forecast or a measurement of the effect of shade infrastructure.

coverage.place_label: South Africa; map product's metric resolution is not reported here

method.description: Summary of the NCCIS public page describing national temperature and rainfall change maps; individual map files and metadata were not retrieved.
method.model_or_protocol_version: Median of six dynamically downscaled GCMs; RCP 4.5 and RCP 8.5 (as described on the page)

uncertainty.description: This page summary does not establish product-specific ensemble spread, calibration uncertainty, exact map resolution, or an indicator value for Johannesburg.

review.rationale: Methodology record grounded in a public catalogue page; a specific downloadable product has not yet been independently verified.

limitations: The 1971-2000 baseline and 2021-2050 projection are different windows; the broad interval must not be presented as continuous observation.
The page states a median of six dynamically downscaled models; it does not provide this claim with a numeric uncertainty range.
Do not reinterpret national maps as 25 m, street-level or parcel-level evidence.
